title: Body-worn camera footage - attempted traffic stop and driveway arrest of Kevin Finley (Winter Springs PD)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

This request concerns the same records as my email request to the Winter Springs Police Department of October 20, 2026 (sent to wspdrecords@winterspringsfl.org, subject "Public Records Request (Ch. 119, F.S.) - Body-Worn Camera and Related Records - Attempted Traffic Stop and Arrest of Kevin Finley"). Records Clerk Brian Reeves replied that the footage is available for $2.50, that video cannot be sent electronically, and that it is provided on USB by mail only. Because I am located outside the United States, I am submitting this request through MuckRock so that the USB can be mailed to MuckRock's U.S. mailing address shown in this message. Please treat it as the delivery route for that earlier request rather than as a separate new request.

Records requested:
1. The body-worn-camera video, and any in-car camera video, of the attempted traffic stop and subsequent arrest of Kevin Finley in his driveway in Winter Springs (charges: fleeing or attempting to elude and reckless driving; judgment of acquittal in Seminole County, reported in September 2026), i.e. the footage the Department has already identified as available.
2. If available electronically at no charge, the incident/arrest report and the CAD event chronology for the same incident, sent by email to this MuckRock address.

Please send any invoice, including postage, through this request before mailing; no charge is authorized unless it is confirmed through this request. Please include the WSPD case number with the response.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

rkg
